work: Pure 3D Cryo-EM structure-to-DMS modulator-rescue benchmark evaluating whether 6 Cryo-EM structural features from 6MSM, 5UAK, and 8EIQ (excluding sub-domain and variant-class indicators) improve log2(VX-661+VX-445 Mut/WT) prediction over baseline log2(DMSO) OLS on the locked Tedman et al. 2025 holdout.

claims.statement: Over 565 common Chain A auth_seq_id C-alpha atoms in TMD1 (77..360) union TMD2 (859..1155), Kabsch/Horn rigid superposition of deltaF508+Trikafta CFTR (8EIQ) onto WT ATP-bound CFTR (6MSM) yields TMD RMSD = 0.843794 A (< 1.5 A pre-registered control), with 5UAK->6MSM TMD RMSD = 5.009998 A (556 CA) and WJX-CV6 minimum heavy-atom separation = 30.013875 A.
claims.dataset: tools/cftr-model/data/6MSM.cif.gz, 5UAK.cif.gz, and 8EIQ.cif.gz (RCSB PDB CC0 1.0) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_dms_3d_structure/results_2026-11-24.json

methods.name: 3x3 cross-covariance SVD Kabsch superposition
methods.difference: computes SO(3) rigid transform via 3x3 H^T H Jacobi eigendecomposition and modified Gram-Schmidt SVD

methods.name: Horn 1987 4x4 quaternion eigensystem superposition
methods.difference: separate mmCIF parser solving rigid alignment via 4x4 Davenport/Horn quaternion Jacobi eigensolver without sharing code

claims.statement: On the locked 67 held-out CFTR variants across 59 unexposed codons (zero overlap with dev or PRED-0010), untreated-expression OLS (log2 VX-661+VX-445 ~ log2 DMSO fitted on 167 dev variants) reproduces held-out MAE = 0.451487 log2(Mut/WT), matching #396 within 1e-6.
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/ALT 9-6-24 CFTR DMS Expanded Library Master Tables.xlsx (sheet All_variants, CC BY 4.0) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_dms_3d_structure/results_2026-11-24.json

methods.name: Centered covariance 1D OLS fit on dev
methods.difference: computes 1D OLS normal equations directly from dev means and cross-products

methods.name: Cholesky L L^T 2x2 independent OLS solver
methods.difference: separate XLSX XML reader solving 2x2 normal equations via Cholesky factorization

claims.statement: On the same 67 held-out variants (59 unexposed codons), partial-penalized Ridge adding the 6 fold-imputed, dev-standardized Cryo-EM 3D structural features (rbf_wjx, rbf_cv6, cn_10A_6msm, bfactor_6msm, disp_5uak_6msm, struct_unresolved; alpha=100.0 chosen by 5-fold dev CV, zero sub-domain or variant-class indicators) yields held-out MAE = 0.450918 log2(Mut/WT) vs dev-CV MAE = 0.399628.
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/ALT 9-6-24 CFTR DMS Expanded Library Master Tables.xlsx (CC BY 4.0) paired with 6MSM/5UAK/8EIQ mmCIFs (CC0 1.0) in benchmarks/cftr_dms_3d_structure/results_2026-11-24.json

methods.name: 3x3 SVD Kabsch + Gaussian elimination 8x8 partial Ridge
methods.difference: computes 3D features via 3x3 SVD Kabsch alignment and solves 8x8 partial-penalized normal equations by partial-pivoting Gaussian elimination

methods.name: Horn quaternion + Cholesky L L^T 8x8 independent solver
methods.difference: separate mmCIF and XLSX XML parsers using Horn 4x4 quaternion superposition and Cholesky L L^T linear solver

claims.statement: Pre-registered hypothesis predicting >= 10% held-out log2 MAE reduction over stronger baseline (dmso_ols) from pure 3D Cryo-EM features with 10,000-resample 59-cluster 95% bootstrap CI > 0 is refuted: observed relative reduction is +0.1261% (0.450918 vs 0.451487 log2, delta=0.000569) and 95% CI is [-0.065011, 0.066022].
